description: This file is a shell script used for testing the configuration and performance of git pack-objects compression features. It sets up objects, runs tests with different compression parameters, and verifies the resulting pack file sizes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specific command sequence.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after a test case.

methods.name: test_file_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a specified file.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
